rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: MCP OSINT Server provides a suite of network reconnaissance tools for open-source intelligence gathering through a unified interface. Built by Himanshu Sanecha using the FastMCP framework, it integrates common OSINT utilities including WHOIS lookups, Nmap scans, DNS reconnaissance (via dnsrecon, dig, and host), and domain typosquatting detection with dnstwist. The implementation runs these tools either individually or concurrently through a parallel execution feature, making it ideal for security researchers, network administrators, and digital investigators who need quick access to domain intelligence without switching between multiple command-line tools.
